scripts.setup: npm run setup:db && npm run setup:deps && npm run db:migrate
scripts.setup:deps: npm --prefix apps/web ci && uv --directory apps/server sync
scripts.setup:ci: npm --prefix apps/web ci && uv --directory apps/server sync --locked
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && uv --directory apps/server run ruff check . && uv --directory apps/server run ruff format --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && uv --directory apps/server run mypy src tests
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/web test && node --test scripts/database-env.test.mjs && node scripts/server.mjs pytest
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
